minutes.headline: PACC kept its officers, heard studio-move and finance updates, and put off setting the FY25 meeting schedule until Steve returns.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee continued its existing officers by a single cast ballot, approved the June minutes, and heard the manager report on the studio move, new affiliates, programming and a year-end balance with some revenue still unposted. A long off-agenda talk followed on the town master plan and the 2028 celebration. The meeting-date discussion was tabled, with dates to be worked out by email and the next meeting set for the 5th.

Setting meeting dates by email, outside an open meeting, means the FY25 schedule will reach residents only when it is announced or posted.
